reason: Primary abstract reviewed: Clock meshes are an essential technique in high-performance VLSI systems to minimize skew and handle On-Chip Variation (OCV), especially in nanometer technologies. However, analyzing meshes is difficult due to reconvergent paths and multi-source drivers. The industrial standard is to use SPICE simulation since static timing analysis (STA) tools can not handle mesh loops.
